title: ACR Context Fabric Investigation Request v1

prior_window_receipts.description: CHAOS-3900 W1: winr_-namespaced receipts naming a prior result's own WindowClarification option. A NEW, parallel field to prior_subject_receipts, not an overload of it -- the match target and effect both differ.

prior_kind_receipts.description: CHAOS-3900 P1: kindr_-namespaced receipts naming a prior result's own StructureNeeds.kind_options entry. A NEW, parallel field, not an overload of prior_subject_receipts or prior_window_receipts -- the match target and effect both differ.

prior_anchor_receipts.description: CHAOS-3900 P1: ancr_-namespaced receipts naming a prior result's own StructureNeeds.anchor_options entry.

prior_handle_receipts.description: CHAOS-3900 P1: handr_-namespaced receipts naming a prior result's own StructureNeeds.handle_options entry.

prior_candidate_receipts.description: CHAOS-4012: candr_-namespaced receipts naming a prior result's own StructureNeeds.candidate_options entry.

parent_result_id.description: Result id of the investigation this turn follows. Optional. Seeds the same-conversation carry walk only; it never binds the named result's subjects into this turn. Bounded identically to prior_*_receipts[].result_id so the two can never disagree about what a well-formed result id is.

expected_kinds.description: CHAOS-3972 P3, design brief section 2.3/2.0/DP12(b): the caller's own explicit expected_kind guess(es). Per the DP12(b) uniform surface split, this NEVER mints question_stated authority by itself -- on the MCP surface it enters at inferred_default/explicit_unattributed (drives census-narrowing and offer-shaping only); every other surface keeps 3900 v5.2's ordinary question_stated rule.

subject_handles.description: CHAOS-3972 P3, design brief section 2.3: grammar-typed handle values the caller already knows. pattern_id must name one of the closed handle-grammar registry entries this deployment discloses via StructureNeeds.accepted_grammars -- never free text or a caller-supplied regex.
